game: Season s3 is live: the game now runs the s3 rules. Souls, Ancestral items and Magic Tower items that used to be s2-only are allowed in the season again.
New room M025 "Molten Abyss Fortress": eight new monsters, the dummy boss included, and magma mushroom gathering points.
Dragon Knight is the seventh playable hero: five profession tiers, an 88-node tree and 11 abilities.
24 new gear items (0659–0682) with their Ancestral versions, recipes, materials and fate stones.
Eight new potions, Triumphant Vintage and profession rune bags.
Seals: every Dragon Knight seal gained tier IV, G619 "Dragon Quake" is new and G603/G607 are removed; several seals were reworked.
12 new "Molten Abyss" nodes T1500–T1512 in the common talent tree.
The battle pass is reworked: 100 levels instead of 80, eight weekly and six season tasks, updated rewards.
The data gained 12 new DLC bosses, including the ice and poison dragons; none is tied to a room yet.
Details are in the FAQ: [[faq:s3/s3|"Season s3: what's new"]] — locations, heroes, equipment, items, runes and the battle pass, one tab each.
wiki: The wiki reads s3 data: Items, Consumables, Craft, Progression, Heroes, Monsters, Sky and the Calculator now use season s3.
FAQ: the "Season s3" tab was rewritten — eight sub-tabs instead of three mixed sections.
FAQ: "Locations and activities", "Drops", "Vendors and fragments", "Experience and season", "Debuffs" and "Damage and its multipliers" were updated.
Calculator: Crystal Maiden is gone, full-progression stats no longer include the s2 tower tree, and permanent buffs moved to their own column with their own sum.
Patch notes can now link straight into the FAQ section that explains them.

game: The Lava Mortar (M025) got its full fight: seven new monsters. The Fel Tombstone wakes when a hero comes near and keeps spitting out fire spiders (the spiders burst on death); waiting there are the Burning Plush Golem, the Devourer’s Servant, the mini-boss Devourer Warlord (800,000 health) and the Serpent-Tamer Shaman, who summons serpent guards, stacks the Serpent Curse and shackles the hero at ten stacks.

Nine new abilities for those monsters: Devouring Stride (six seconds of crushing steps), Flesh Bonds (all damage to the chained monsters is carried to one of them), Triple Shove, Lava Upheaval and more — every one of them described in the game’s own words.

Endless: the Infinity Commemorative Medal unlocks and upgrades an account badge that persists between seasons. Each level of any unlocked badge grants +1% luck, up to +50% from all badges; hiding a badge does not take the bonus away.

Endless: the Endless Special is a drink with ten uses. Every bottle permanently adds 0.5% global critical strike chance (up to +5%), and each drink also grants +5% for ten minutes — refreshed, not stacked.
The build carries the first pieces of a new room, M026: a map, two “flame spinner” models and twelve encrypted scripts. Nothing in the game announces it yet — not the room list, not the interface.
The game’s own translation now covers the Phantom Assassin’s Boomerang, Lina’s Burning Thunder, the sigils (G216 “Whirling Boomerang” among them) and the endless team lobby’s strings.
Numbers on existing content did not change: items, monsters, pools, fate stones and locations are additions only.
wiki: Data refreshed to v1.509: the Monsters tab lists seven new M025 units and their nine abilities, Items has the Infinity Commemorative Medal, Consumables has the Endless Special, and the data knows rooms M025 and M026 with their spawn points.
The hand-written translations of Boomerang, Burning Thunder and the sigils are replaced by the pack’s own: where the game now speaks the reader’s language, the wiki uses its words.

Items: the catalogue is cleared of consumables and recipes (they have sections of their own, and a recipe’s card opens from a direct link or from the monsters that drop it), and an item with nothing to be made from no longer shows an empty recipe line.

The item card leads with two full-width blocks — the stats and what the item does — the range note under the stats is shorter, and the reforge table has a new “Stone” column: what a fate stone costs on top at each reforge level.
The reforge table itself was a step ahead of the game — every step and the total were about 15% over — and now matches it.
The hidden room M015 “Enchanted Forest” is gone from Monsters, Progression and the FAQ: the game has no such room.

game: The pak's open data did not change: items, monsters, talents, sigils and drops are the same as in v1.506–1.507.

Endless (the Sky): the build carries modules for item ownership after a run, settling and persisting that run's reward, and a leaderboard. Their rules live in encrypted code, so the wiki describes them by file name.
Paid treasure chests (the gacha): the internal logic was reworked — the one large change in this patch.
Smaller code changes: talent-tree availability, the rules for transferring paid items on the Exchange, and the save-data cache.
Battle pass screen: the animated hero gained a smoke layer, continuing v1.507's "wind" animation.
wiki: No section changed: the game data is the same as in v1.506–1.507, so no numbers had to be rebuilt.
The pak is about 42 MB lighter: unused particles were pruned, and some service files come from the author's other working copy. Neither touches the wiki's data.

game: "Shattered Axe" and its Ancestral version: pressing the active again no longer ramps up the bonus; the stat snapshot is now taken without its own buff (before, the value grew with every cast).
The battle pass screen was redone: the hero is built from layers and animated with "wind", and the season's title, motto and quote are now shown as text and translated into Russian.
wiki: New "Heroes" tab: for every profession, its abilities (with numbers and descriptions), the tree node that unlocks them and the runes that boost them.
Runes and sigils now appear on the "Items" tab, with a "Rune" filter; clicking a rune on a hero card opens its card with the description.
The FAQ is now organised into sub-tabs (topics within a section are switched by a row at the top): "Locations and activities", "Items: forging/sets/code vs. tooltip", "Season s3", "Battle pass".
Added this patch notes tab; the calculator became a separate button in the header.

game: New Phantom Assassin ability, "Boomerang" (pa_013): a dart flies to the target spot and comes back, dealing 400% of attack damage on each pass; it can stop and spin.

New Lina ability, "Scorching Thunder" (lina_014): 700% of intelligence to the target, then the discharge jumps up to 4 times between enemies within 450; +10% damage per 100 intelligence (up to +300%).

Four sigils for each of the two abilities: Phantom Assassin gets "Whirl", "Sharpness", "Soul Chase" and "Burst" (G216–G219), Lina gets "Lingering Thunder", "Five Thunders", "Spirit Thunder" and "Thunder Embers" (G317–G320).
Phantom Assassin's sigil "Blade Fusion" (G215) was removed; "Burst" works in its place.
Endless: team lobby, a queue with a leader; the roster can be locked, and the run can start from a chosen floor; skipped floors do not grant season contribution points.
"Trade Expansion Scroll" and its advanced version: permanently +1 and +2 selling slots on the Exchange.
Scripts cut in v1.503 are back: "Shadow Strike Resonance", boss phase summons, elite abilities.
wiki: All eight new sigils were translated from scratch (in the Russian localisation they were in Chinese); "Blade Fusion" was removed.
The "Shadow Strike Resonance" card and a note about the team lobby in "Sky"; the "Season s3" FAQ section gained tables of the new abilities and sigils.

game: Minor patch: three rewards (Mysterious Key, Guild Charter and Cube Special) are marked as non-dropping: they can only be granted directly and do not drop from chests.
Support for a third-party hosting platform for dedicated servers was prepared.
wiki: No wiki sections changed: for players the patch changed nothing, the game data is the same as in v1.503.

game: New room M025 "Lava Mortar": the task is to close the lava valves while the mortars flood the arena.

Shrine blessings (runes): at a shrine on the map the player picks one of three runes: haste, damage, arcane, regeneration, shield, purification or revive; each has stacks and a contract limit, and the "Purification Rune" removes erosion.
New s3 sigils: Axe: "Second Strike" (G115, repeats "Mighty Strike" within 6 seconds) and "Rallying Roar" (G116, armor for allies within 450); Phantom Assassin: "Blade Fusion" (G215).

s3 balance: Axe's "Challenge Roar" (armor 60 → 30%), "Berserk Fury" (damage reduction 20 → 10%) and "Berserker's Suppression" healing (5 → 3%) were nerfed; Void Spirit's "Sigil Slash" was buffed (slash 50 → 100%, mark 100 → 200%, flurry repeat 30 → 12 s).
"Roulette Chain" in s3 no longer crits with its extra hit.
Activation codes were cut down: two remain (SANCUNDEAI and LAOMODEAI).
New consumables: +25% speed for 60 seconds, +10 damage and +30% attack speed for 120 seconds, a warming potion, an evacuation scroll; "Triumphant Vintage" is s3 only.
wiki: FAQ section on blessing runes (what each one does, stacks and limits) and a description of the new room.
Axe and Phantom Assassin sigils added, the "Season s3" section updated.

game: Battle pass reworked (the "v5" UI): weekly tasks now give 2000 XP instead of 3000, seasonal ones 6000 instead of 2000, and tasks got goals.
Pass rewards recalculated, "Eternal Recovery Cards" added (Free at level 75, Premium at 15/45/75).
"Triumphant Vintage" (P274): +1 to all attributes PERMANENTLY (up to 30 bottles) and +10% movement speed for 10 minutes.
14 bosses got their own phase summons: at 60% health the boss goes into a transition and summons minions, then enters a second phase (+10% damage, +10% damage reduction, +20% speed and attack).
Elite monster abilities and the appearance system (hero looks), pet attributes, the "cat", the leaderboard, a fatigue indicator.
The UI is built from loadable "groups"; the shop got a "Codex", plus a pet modal.
wiki: The pass section was rebuilt for v5 (tasks, rewards, tax-free levels); descriptions of phase summons and the UI were added.

game: Dragon Knight, third pass: "Sweeping Strike" reworked: two charges, 6 s restore time, cast at a point, 350 cone (550 and 120° in Dragon Form).

New Dragon Knight sigils: G617 "Long Breath" (a 4-second "Breathe Fire" channel, one breath every 2/1.5/1 s) and G618 "Dragon's Might Bash" (two stacks: a ×1.3/1.6/2 shield bash and a shield of 5/8/10% of max health).
Sigil G602 "Whelp" reworked: summons 1/2/4 whelps with 50/80/120% damage, now "Multibreath".
"Dragon Charge" shortened: 950 → 500 (600 in Dragon Form).
Battle pass: rewards rewritten; some levels give a tax-free Exchange allowance (up to 100,000 / 1,000,000 gold and 2 / 5 contracts); XP for a successful evacuation is 200, no more than 6000 per week.
Shop: the "Season Pass" price went up from 590 to 1280, and pass levels can now be bought: only with Premium and no higher than level 80.
Exchange: the UI shows the tax-free limits for gold and contracts (the tax extension from v1.491).
Drow Ranger in s3: "Arrow Hail" ("Ability 005" in game) ×1.6 → ×2.6, "Winter Array" 300 → 225, "Frost Volley" got an attack speed threshold and cap (200/800).
Void Spirit in s3: "Aether Remnant" 280 → 380%, "Sigil Slash" rewritten (pushes and pulls by exactly 36), new runes G500/G507/G508.
wiki: Dragon Knight sigils (G617/G618, reworked G602/G607/G609) and a section on the Exchange with tax-free limits.
Updated s3 hero cards (Drow, Void Spirit) in the "Season s3" section.
